reason: Why pay over ₹21,000 a year for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free and already handle our day-to-day workflow? Even with the stress of 10 PM ROC filing annexure reviews and deadline panic over article clerks, I am not paying for an annual subscription when our existing routine costs zero.
objection: Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, and will article clerks actually follow these blueprints instead of me still having to review everything late at night?
would_change_my_mind: If testing the free pilot during the October ROC rush proves that the maker-checker audit trail eliminates article clerk filing mistakes and spares me from 10 PM annexure reviews.
